name: Spaghetti Squash with Veggie Ground, Kale & Cheesy Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium spaghetti squash
1 ½ bunches kale
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim each spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheets.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread crumbs and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool. (Reserve pot for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Wipe the pot clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
24 oz veggie ground, plant based

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice garlic.
When the veggie ground is done, add garlic, Italian seasoning, and crushed red pepper to the pot. Cook, stirring often, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and set aside for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan. Add to the bowl with the bread crumbs and stir to combine. Set aside.
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

Return pot with veggie ground to medium-high heat. Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the kale is tender and the sausage is warmed through, about 1 minute.
Juice lemons into the pot and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Season with salt.
To serve, divide spaghetti squash between plates or bowls. Top with veggie ground-kale sauté and cheesy bread crumbs. Enjoy!
